requirements: R1: Align MaterialEntity.file_data mapping with PostgreSQL bytea column type to resolve startup schema-validation failure

slices.title: Fix MaterialEntity file_data mapping for PostgreSQL bytea
slices.jtbd: When implementing the entity mapping fix for this epic, I want to configure the file_data field to expect a binary JDBC type instead of an oid, so that the application startup remediation is achieved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend application connects to PostgreSQL
When the Spring Boot context and Hibernate schema validation initialize
Then no schema-validation error occurs for the materials table
And the application successfully exposes the health check endpoint
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce backend startup failures due to schema validation from 1 to 0
